evals.name: basic-bake-demo6-json
evals.prompt: can you generate a scene from layouts/demo_6.json
evals.expected_output: Runs json_to_scene.py on layouts/demo_6.json with --verify, prints VERIFY OK with entity counts, and flags the layout-only caveat (setup_demo_train stub). Does NOT hand-write a new converter.

evals.name: named-output-bake
evals.prompt: bake layouts/demo_6.json into a python scene file called yard_demo.py with scene id yard_demo
evals.expected_output: Runs the baker writing to yard_demo.py with --scene-id yard_demo and --verify; reports the output path, SCENE_ID, and VERIFY OK counts.

evals.name: stale-json-match-current-scene
evals.prompt: convert demo_6.json into a .py scene, but I want it to match the CURRENT demo_6 (it has way more stations than the json)
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that layouts/demo_6.json is stale vs demo_6.py, so serializes the live demo_6 network (to_layout_dict) to a JSON first and bakes THAT, rather than the stale file. Reports counts and the layout-only caveat.
